reference.publication_policy: First validated generation only. Subsequent --generate must match all asset and manifest bytes; never repin or overwrite. Manifest SHA-256 is returned separately in execution evidence (no self-hash).

reference.authority: Analytic sine PCM; independent FFmpeg looping reference. No Media3 output used.
negative_controls: one second music then three seconds silence

reference.font: None. Original analytic ellipse/rectangle primitives; no font dependency or copied outlines.
limits: Bounded OI topology, not general OCR or pixel-exact glyph identity.
Confusable glyphs with the same topology are not distinguished.
OEM fonts outside fixed bounds fail honestly; no calibration or fallback.
All frame PTS and four unoccluded code bits checked; nine text/spatial probes.
Fixed center exclusion hides covered marker regions; horizontal motion remains checked.
Generated titles, other strings/styles/positions and compositions unverified.
reference.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

expectations.geometry: Original analytic ellipse ring and rectangle stem, normalized to 48px em
expectations.normalization: Known display scaledDensity only; never measured candidate bounds
expectations.title: 30 static frames / 1 second, white OI on black, silent PCM
expectations.main: Original 96 frames / 4 seconds at 24fps, all barcodes and frozen spatial probes
expectations.audio: Three title silence windows, twelve original tone/RMS windows; continuous PCM
expectations.tolerances: Unchanged text-topology-1 and base v1; black background MAE <=18
expectations.limits: One fixed normal OI configuration; topology not OCR; no arbitrary styles/combinations

reference.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

reference.scope: Frozen independent LOCAL encoded controls; not device export evidence

reference.use: Export vectors only. Pull real device outputs and run oracle.py verify for full validation.

parent_next_steps: Wait for media3-device-selftest migration ownership to finish.
Pin fixture and manifest hashes; confirm migrated EditConfig matches vectors.
Add Android export driver for all 12 fresh configs; export actual standard.mp4.
Pull real outputs; run offline verifier per case and retain device/codec/app revision evidence.
Do not treat local reference verification as device export success.
limitations: No Android device evidence yet; these are independent local encoded-media tests.
No overlays, arbitrary rotations, odd sizes, HDR, metadata-rotated input, multiple clips, or variable frame rate.
Tone windows measure envelope, pitch and segment identity, not sample-exact waveform phase.
Spatial checks cover nine frames plus barcode on every decoded frame, not every pixel of every frame.
AAC start/tail and Sonic-vs-atempo transitions allowed only within documented bounds; no device calibration yet.
Tool-version-pinned generation; other FFmpeg builds may produce different hashes. Use shipped fixture as standard.

source.encoding: H.264 yuv420p limited-range SMPTE170M/BT.601, AAC mono 128kbps
source.ownership: Original mathematical patterns and synthesized tones; no external media.

conventions.coordinate_system: Display-oriented source, top-left origin, x right, y down.
conventions.crop: Pixel-edge rectangle [left,top,right,bottom); normalized by source width/height.
order: divide video PTS by speed; pitch-preserving audio tempo
conventions.resize: Specified output height, preserve aspect, no letterbox/stretch; v1 exact even dimensions only.
conventions.rounding: All crop/trim boundaries exact even pixels/integer source frames; no rounding ambiguity.
conventions.reference_interpolation: FFmpeg bilinear encoded reference; independent NumPy/Pillow bilinear RGB expectations.
conventions.timeline: PTS rebased to zero. source_time = start + output_PTS * speed.
conventions.speed: 0.5 and 2.0, pitch preserved. Native retimed FPS or 24fps CFR resampling allowed; VFR rejected.
conventions.mute: Audio track must be absent, not just silent, matching inspected EditConfig behavior.
conventions.volume: Amplitude multiplier, not dB; 0.25 is -12.0412 dB.
conventions.display_rotation: Decode display orientation before checking geometry/pixels; rotation metadata may be used.
conventions.barcode: bit i at x=96+18*i, y=96..112; complement at y=112..128; 235 for one,20 for zero.

moving_markers.check: Inset both source rectangles by 2 pixels, transform, compare mean RGB at nine probes.

conventions.reference_authority: Analytic pixels/timecode/tone equations are authority. Reference MP4 bytes are NOT expected device bytes.

limitations: No Android device evidence yet; these are independent local encoded-media tests.
No overlays, arbitrary rotations, odd sizes, HDR, metadata-rotated input, multiple clips, or variable frame rate.
Tone windows measure envelope, pitch and segment identity, not sample-exact waveform phase.
Spatial checks cover nine frames plus barcode on every decoded frame, not every pixel of every frame.
AAC start/tail and Sonic-vs-atempo transitions allowed only within documented bounds; no device calibration yet.
Tool-version-pinned generation; other FFmpeg builds may produce different hashes. Use shipped fixture as standard.

reference.scope: LOCAL ONLY; not Android/Media3/device export evidence
